result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility continental crosswalk and paved sidewalks with curb ramps. However, the wide roadway lacks a pedestrian refuge island and dedicated pedestrian signals are not visible, which may increase exposure risk for people crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with a marked continental crosswalk and traffic signal control. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, large trees and parked vehicles may create sightline challenges for both drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Large street trees and parked vehicles near the intersection corners may obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right and left corners of the intersection near the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicular signals which may lead to conflicts with turning traffic.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve the visibility of pedestrians to approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalk markings and curb ramps within a residential context. However, the wide one-way roadway and parked vehicles near the crossing point create potential visibility and speed hazards for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb line immediately adjacent to the crosswalk limit sightlines between drivers and pedestrians entering the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the right-hand curb line leading up to the intersection.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection, requiring pedestrians to interpret vehicle signals.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.
